richiami.difetto: It has been identified that due to possible incorrect assembly of the rear axle hub through omission of the bearing retaining nut split pin. The potential exists for detachment of a rear hub assembly.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will be checked to ensure completeness of the assembly and the presence of split pins in both rear hubs.
richiami.titolo: POTENTIAL DETACHMENT OF REAR HUB ASSEMBLY

richiami.difetto: Non-conformity of weld attaching the seat belt buckle brackets to passenger seat frames.  Affecting all passenger compartment seat locations.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the Minibuses within the affected poplulation and fit a modified (bolted) belt buckle to the seat frame.

richiami.difetto: A batch of minibus vehicles were produced to a deviated front passenger seat mounting condition.
richiami.titolo: SEAT MOUNTINGS MAY NOT COMPLY WITH HOMOLGATION REQUIREMENTS
